content.json:
# HR Policy Benchmark
Connected Agent Framework benchmark health from Application Insights. Prompt and response content are not displayed.

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Name == "benchmark.case"
| where isnotempty(tostring(Properties["app.benchmark.experiment.id"]))
| summarize samples=count(), failures=countif(Success == false), p50=percentile(DurationMs, 50), p95=percentile(DurationMs, 95), p99=percentile(DurationMs, 99) by experimentId=tostring(Properties["app.benchmark.experiment.id"]), configurationId=tostring(Properties["app.benchmark.configuration.id"])
| order by p95 desc
content.title: Latency and failures by experiment

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Name startswith "chat "
| where isnotempty(tostring(Properties["app.benchmark.experiment.id"]))
| summarize inputTokens=sum(toint(Properties["gen_ai.usage.input_tokens"])), outputTokens=sum(toint(Properties["gen_ai.usage.output_tokens"])), responses=dcount(tostring(Properties["gen_ai.response.id"])) by experimentId=tostring(Properties["app.benchmark.experiment.id"]), responseModel=tostring(Properties["gen_ai.response.model"])
content.title: Service-reported model usage
